title: Squaremas
statementMd:
You are given two integers $m$ and $n$. Print a grid of integers with $m$ rows and $n$ columns such that the four corners of any rectangular subgrid add up to a perfect square. Each integer must lie in the range $[1, 10^9]$. Note that we are only interested in rectangular subgrids that have four corners. Your solution must contain at least two different numbers. It can be shown that under the given constraints, a solution always exists.

An example on a $3 \times 3$ grid is shown below. Several examples of rectangular subgrids are highlighted. The four corners of each rectangle are colored red. Note that the entire grid is also considered a subgrid.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f93e9044f5fe1a5701fa117a52d4826031477d26.png)

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 50$). The description of the test cases follows.

Each test case consists of a single line containing two integers $m$ and $n$ ($2 \le m, n \le 100$) — the required number of rows and columns of the grid.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $m$ and the sum of $n$ over all test cases are at most $100$.

## Output

For each test case, output $m$ rows, each containing $n$ integers satisfying the above conditions.

If there are multiple solutions, you may output any.

## Note

The first test case is shown in the image below.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99694dc0e0bca14444aee693128712036a7dcff8.png)

The second test case is from the image in the problem statement. There are 9 rectangles to consider. In all, we have

- $3 + 2 + 31 + 13 = 49 = 7^2$
- $2 + 29 + 13 + 37 = 81 = 9^2$
- $31 + 13 + 1 + 19 = 64 = 8^2$
- $13 + 37 + 19 + 31 = 100 = 10^2$
- $3 + 29 + 31 + 37 = 100 = 10^2$
- $31 + 37 + 1 + 31 = 100 = 10^2$
- $3 + 2 + 1 + 19 = 25 = 5^2$
- $2 + 29 + 19 + 31 = 81 = 9^2$
- $3 + 29 + 1 + 31 = 64 = 8^2$
statementZhMd:
你会得到两个整数 $m$ 和 $n$。请输出一个有 $m$ 行、$n$ 列的整数网格，使得任意一个矩形子网格的四个角上的数字之和都是完全平方数。每个整数必须在 $[1, 10^9]$ 范围内。注意，我们只考虑有四个角的矩形子网格。你的解必须包含至少两个不同的数字。可以证明，在给定约束下，解总是存在。

下面展示了一个 $3 \times 3$ 网格的例子。图中标出了几个矩形子网格，每个矩形的四个角用红色标示。注意，整个网格也被视为一个子网格。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f93e9044f5fe1a5701fa117a52d4826031477d26.png)

## 输入格式

每个输入包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 50$）。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例仅包含一行，含有两个整数 $m$ 和 $n$（$2 \le m, n \le 100$），分别表示所需网格的行数和列数。

保证所有测试用例的 $m$ 之和以及 $n$ 之和均不超过 $100$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出 $m$ 行，每行包含 $n$ 个满足上述条件的整数。

如果有多个解，可以输出任意一个。

## 说明

第一个测试用例如下图所示。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99694dc0e0bca14444aee693128712036a7dcff8.png)

第二个测试用例来自题目描述中的图片。需要考虑 9 个矩形。具体来说：

- $3 + 2 + 31 + 13 = 49 = 7^2$
- $2 + 29 + 13 + 37 = 81 = 9^2$
- $31 + 13 + 1 + 19 = 64 = 8^2$
- $13 + 37 + 19 + 31 = 100 = 10^2$
- $3 + 29 + 31 + 37 = 100 = 10^2$
- $31 + 37 + 1 + 31 = 100 = 10^2$
- $3 + 2 + 1 + 19 = 25 = 5^2$
- $2 + 29 + 19 + 31 = 81 = 9^2$
- $3 + 29 + 1 + 31 = 64 = 8^2$
